links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting with neither PEFT nor RAG applied
links.outcome: Multi-label EHR classification performance across accuracy, macro-averaged precision, recall, and F1 score
links.effect: Few-shot learning consistently outperformed zero-shot learning; no numeric scores reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Few-shot learning consistently outperforms zero-shot learning when neither PEFT nor RAG is applied.

links.comparator_used: Off-the-shelf Llama 3.1-8B without parameter-efficient fine-tuning, in both zero-shot and few-shot prompting
links.outcome: Accuracy, macro-averaged precision, recall and F1 across four clinical tasks (agitation in dementia, depression in dementia, frailty index, malnutrition risk factors)
links.effect: PEFT significantly enhanced model performance in both zero-shot and few-shot learning. No numeric values given in the abstract.
links.quote: Notably, PEFT significantly enhances model performance in both zero-shot and few-shot learning; however, RAG improves performance only in few-shot learning.

links.comparator_used: Same Llama 3.1-8B without retrieval augmentation (model knowledge and prompt only), in zero-shot and few-shot settings
links.outcome: Accuracy, macro-averaged precision, recall and F1 across four clinical tasks
links.effect: RAG improved performance only in few-shot learning, with no improvement reported for zero-shot. No numeric values given in the abstract.
